related_questions.question: Can a low temperature mean you are sick?

text_blocks.snippet: Yes, a low body temperature can indicate illness in some cases, but it can also be normal for some individuals. A low temperature, specifically below 95°F (35°C), can be a sign of hypothermia, a dangerous condition requiring immediate medical attention. However, some individuals naturally run a bit cooler, and low temperatures can also be associated with certain medical conditions or medications.
snippet_highlighted_words: Yes, a low body temperature can indicate illness in some cases, but it can also be normal for some individuals

text_blocks.snippet: When low temperature might indicate illness:

list.title: Hypothermia:
list.snippet: When body temperature drops below 95°F (35°C), it can lead to hypothermia, a medical emergency. Symptoms include shivering, low blood pressure, confusion, and loss of coordination.

list.title: Sepsis:
list.snippet: In some cases, sepsis, a severe infection, can cause a low body temperature as part of the body's response.

list.title: Underlying Medical Conditions:
list.snippet: Certain conditions like hypothyroidism, diabetes, and Parkinson's disease can affect the body's ability to regulate temperature.

list.title: Certain Medications:
list.snippet: Some medications, such as antidepressants and sedatives, can also lead to lower body temperatures.

text_blocks.snippet: When a low temperature might be normal:

list.snippet: Individual Variation: Some individuals naturally have lower body temperatures than the "average" of 98.6°F (37°C).
Age: Older adults and infants may be more susceptible to low body temperatures.
Time of Day: Body temperature naturally fluctuates throughout the day, with lower temperatures often occurring in the morning.

If you feel sick and have a low temperature, it's best to consult with a healthcare professional to determine the cause and appropriate course of action, especially if you experience symptoms like confusion, dizziness, or difficulty breathing.
A low temperature combined with other symptoms like shivering, confusion, or difficulty breathing should be addressed immediately.
